missing_information_behavior: If any required safety or context information is missing, do not add positive recommendation score; request clarification or escalate.
safety_exclusions: Do not recommend magnesium supplementation where renal clearance may be impaired without clinician clearance.
professional_escalation_conditions: Chronic kidney disease, reduced eGFR, dialysis, hypermagnesemia symptoms or relevant medicines.
population_and_context: Users with known or suspected renal impairment considering magnesium citrate; safety gate only.
dose_constraints: No dose; maintain current safety override and professional review.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Magnesium fact sheet describes toxicity risk with impaired renal function and medicine interactions. This rule remains draft; source passage extraction, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional approval are required before activation.
